hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $8$ are $1, 2, 4,$ and $8.$

$8$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $27$ are $1, 3, 9,$ and $27.$

$27$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $51$ are $1, 3, 17,$ and $51.$

$51$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $53$ are $1$ and $53.$

$53$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $95$ are $1, 5, 19,$ and $95.$

$95$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
